in_sanskrit.name: दशरथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dash means Ten and Rath means Charm, so Dashrath means Ten Charms.

in_hindi.name: दशरथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: Dash means Ten and Rath means Chariot, so Dashrath means Ten Chariots.

in_tamil.name: தசரத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Dasar means Ten and Ratham means Vehicle, so Dashrath means Ten Vehicles.

in_telugu.name: దశరథ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Dasam means Ten and Rathalu means Chariots, so Dashrath means Ten Chariots.

in_marathi.name: Dashrath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dashrath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dashrath is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dash' meaning ten and 'Rath' meaning chariot. This name is associated with King Dashratha of the Ikshvaku dynasty who had ten chariots and was the father of Rama and Lakshmana.
